title: Pneumatic — Extension of the Low Temperature Valve Standard to the Cross-Bleed and Ground Connection Positions
abstract: Retrofit of the low-temperature actuator to the cross-bleed and ground connection valves and installation of a discrete position sensor at all four valve positions.

sections.planning_reason: The earlier bulletin corrected the two engine isolation valves and left the cross-bleed and ground connection valves at the delivered build. Two winters of service showed the same slow response at the cross-bleed valve, producing a delayed cross-bleed start rather than a departure caution, with one operator reporting eight events on a single aircraft in a fortnight. The bleed monitoring computer also had to infer valve position from duct pressure, which is the source of a long-standing complaint about ambiguous fault messages.
sections.description: The bulletin fits the low-temperature actuator to the cross-bleed and ground connection valves, adds a discrete position sensor at each of the four valve positions and wires the sensors to the bleed monitoring computer. The cross-bleed duct is replaced by a sub-assembly carrying the sensor mounting boss.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowl on both sides and get access to the belly fairing in zone 191. Do the removal task AMM-C-36-10-12-000-012-A at the cross-bleed and ground connection positions. Remove the duct D3610123273634 and install the sub-assembly D3610128140349 with the sensor boss. Install the low-temperature actuator and the common regulator D3610120750241 at each of the four positions. Install a position sensor GIR634074-45 at each boss and connect it to the harness installed under Service Bulletin CRN-36-2009. Install the switch KADE183019-31 at the ground connection position. Fit the cushioned clamps EN984959K3 and new swaged collars EN767708K2 at every duct joint. Do the installation task AMM-C-36-10-12-400-012-A and then the four-position travel and reporting test. Close up and record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-11 and CIRRANE-13 aircraft up to MSN C00544 that carry the first low-temperature actuator standard at the engine isolation positions. Aircraft that do not have the position sensing harness installed must first accomplish Service Bulletin CRN-36-2009.
sections.material_note: Kit K3610-2005-01 contains two actuators, four regulators, four position sensors, the cross-bleed duct sub-assembly and the clamp and collar set. Lead time is twenty weeks and the duct sub-assembly is the long-lead item. Removed ducts are not returned.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within forty-eight months of the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
